summary: Mid-campaign check-in on the Kettle & Co winter gift-box campaign. Meta prospecting is at a £38 CPA against a £25 target, Google Search is at £14 and retargeting is on track. Meta results may be under-reported because the pixel stopped firing on the new checkout. The team agreed to shift budget to Search, brief a vertical video and run a landing page A/B test.

tasks.title: Move £2,000 from Meta prospecting to Google Search gift terms
tasks.description: Meta prospecting CPA £38 vs £25 target; Google Search gift terms at £14. Shift £2,000 of the remaining Meta prospecting budget.
tasks.evidence: Let's move £2,000 of the remaining Meta prospecting budget into Google Search gift terms. Omar, can you do that today? / Yes, today.

tasks.title: Fix Meta pixel on the new checkout page
tasks.description: Pixel stopped firing after the site update, so Meta conversions may be under-reported. Fix before judging Meta performance. Raise with the dev team today.
tasks.evidence: The Meta pixel isn't firing on the new checkout page since the site update.

tasks.title: Brief 15-second vertical unboxing video for Reels and TikTok
tasks.description: Format: 15s, vertical. Channels: Instagram Reels and TikTok. Message: the gift box arrives ready to give, no wrapping. Brief the freelancer by Monday 2 November; delivery 13 November.
tasks.evidence: If I brief the freelancer by Monday we'd have it by the 13th. / Do it.

tasks.title: Draft gift guide email for 20 November send
tasks.description: Draft for Hannah's review by 14 November.
tasks.evidence: Yes, draft by the 14th for your review.

tasks.title: Set up landing page A/B test: free shipping vs 10% off
tasks.description: Hypothesis: free shipping messaging converts better than 10% off for gift buyers. Start once the new video is live; run at least two weeks.
tasks.evidence: Lucy, can you set up the A/B test once the video's live? / Sure. I'd want at least two weeks of data.
